protocol:
1. Arrange labeled microcentrifuge tubes in a green tube rack on the lab bench and open the caps of the tubes to be used.

2. Attach a disposable pipette tip to a Transferpette S adjustable micropipette from the tip box.

3. Pipette liquid reagent into an open labeled microcentrifuge tube held in the gloved hand.

4. Place the filled microcentrifuge tube back into the green rack with the cap open.

5. Adjust the Transferpette S micropipette volume dial and prepare the pipette for the next transfer.

6. Change to a fresh disposable pipette tip from the tip box.

7. Pipette liquid reagent into additional labeled microcentrifuge tubes in the green rack, handling one tube at a time.

8. Cap a prepared microcentrifuge tube and mix its contents by flicking the tube with a gloved finger.

9. Retrieve a closed Petri dish containing pink culture medium from another lab area and carry it back to the bench.

10. Place the Petri dish containing pink culture medium on the bench beside the green tube rack and micropipettes.

11. Open a selected microcentrifuge tube and aspirate liquid from it using the Transferpette S micropipette with a disposable tip.

12. Lift the Petri dish lid and dispense the liquid from the micropipette into the pink culture medium.

13. Close the Petri dish lid and gently swirl the dish by hand on the bench to mix the added liquid through the medium.
